entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Nusrat Djahan Mosque is an Ahmadiyya mosque located in Hvidovre, on the outskirts of Copenhagen, Denmark. Completed in 1967, it was the first mosque in Denmark. The mosque was financed solely by the female members of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community. The capacity of the mosque is 120 worshipers.
